title: Chest pain
summary: New or unexplained chest pain, pressure or discomfort. If the pattern is concerning (pressure, severe, persistent or recurring pain, or pain with shortness of breath, cold sweat or dizziness), acute coronary syndrome is a priority cause that must be ruled out; this does not mean it is the most likely cause. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. No clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

immediate.text: Possible cardiac emergency: call for help now; do not wait to see if the symptoms go away.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Call for emergency help now using the mission's means (ship alarm, crew, mission control if the link is up). Do not wait to see if it gets better.
Crew member trained in CPR or defibrillator use: get it ready and use it if needed until more help arrives.

missing_guidance: The card's sources do not specify medication for chest pain: it depends on the mission procedure.

new_pain.text: New chest pain without the warning pattern: monitor and treat it as an emergency if it changes.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: If the pain persists, comes back or comes with shortness of breath, cold sweat, dizziness, or pain in the jaw, neck, back or arms, treat it as an emergency.

missing_guidance: The card's sources do not give self-care steps for chest pain without warning signs.

candidates.label: Acute coronary syndrome (must be ruled out)
candidates.minimum_evidence: Chest pain or pressure with a concerning pattern: persistent, recurring, severe or with shortness of breath, cold sweat or dizziness.

sources.title: CDC: About Heart Attack and Symptoms
